note: As-is baseline captured before any code change, scoped to hooks/notify.sh and its Notification wiring in hooks/hooks.json. flow.mmd shows the defect structurally: the script reads .message and sends, while notification_type (10 distinct values in Claude Code 2.1.220) and .gogo/work/*/state.md are both on disk and both unread. sequence.mmd shows the consequence the user reported: agent_completed fires once per Task subagent return, so a single /gogo:go run emits 4+ identical 'gogo needs your input' pings, and the one real gate is indistinguishable from them.

diagrams.title: As-is: hooks/notify.sh reads only .message, defaults it to 'gogo needs your input' and always sends - notification_type and every state.md are ignored
As-is timing: every gogo-analyst / gogo-reviewer / gogo-tester Task return raises agent_completed, so one run produces 4+ identical pings and none of them marks a real gate
